title: Rush Share After a Recent Ground Shipping Charge, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** A patient of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program who has already paid for a recent shipment pays a share of the priced rush:

- **80 percent** when a ground shipping charge is booked for a shipment that went out in the last 21 days;
- **90 percent** when the newest such shipment went out 22 to 45 days ago.

Otherwise the patient pays the priced rush in full.

## Reading the records

The test reads the enrollment's ground shipping-charge lines. Each is dated with the ship date of the shipment it was charged for; the newest of those dates is compared with today in calendar days.

| Days from the newest ground-charged shipment's ship date to today | Share of the priced rush paid |
|---|---|
| 0 to 21 | 80 percent |
| 22 to 45 | 90 percent |
| 46 or more, or no ground shipping charge on record | the full priced rush |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 30 April, priced rush 9.95)

- Newest ground-charged shipment went out 9 April (21 days): 80 percent, 7.96.
- Went out 8 April (22 days): 90 percent, 8.955 before final rounding.
- Went out 15 March (46 days): the full 9.95.
